get.summary: The signed-in person, their company and what they may do. Call it after sign-in.

put.summary: Saves the person's theme: system, light or dark.

get.summary: The permission catalog, grouped by area.
Who the caller is inside their company: permissions, site scope and support pass. Used by other services.
The company's audit log, newest first. Page with before (an entry id). Filter by supportPassId, or by subjectId (the asset, user, role… an entry is about).

post.summary: Makes an editable custom role with the same permissions (the mockup's Duplicate).

get.summary: People in the company. status: all (default), active, invited, deactivated.

post.summary: Invites a person by email. The response holds the invitation link (shown once).

get.summary: Seats in use against the plan's user limit.

post.summary: Replaces the open invitation with a new link.

delete.summary: Cancels the invitation of someone who hasn't joined, and frees their seat.

get.summary: The company's sites. Every member can read them; roles can be limited to them.
Support passes into this company, newest first, with how many actions each recorded.

post.summary: Who invited you, to which company and with which roles. Shows why it can't be accepted, if so.
Joins the company. Afterwards, sign in again so the token carries the company.
Opens a time-limited support pass. Read-only unless access is "change" (Platform Owner only).
Makes a new invitation link for the client's first Owner (until email sending arrives).
